summary: The comment discusses the controversy surrounding electromagnetic hypersensitivity (EHS) and its impact on health. It presents a personal experience of the author with EHS symptoms and explains the controversy around the condition. The comment also mentions the difficulty in studying and accepting EHS due to variations in effects on living systems. The text cites research linking electromagnetic fields from powerlines and electrical appliances to various health problems, including leukemia, skin cancer, ALS, and miscarriage. This supports the claim that electromagnetic fields have health impacts. Health research and politics
